lines.trans: Chef, I brought you the secret order.
Did you check that no one saw you?
In the corridor it was completely empty.
Excellent, put this box on the table.
The box turned out to be very heavy.
The main thing is that the goods are fresh.
I chose the very best fresh goods.
Our restaurant cannot wait long.
I completed everything quickly and on time.
I hope this secret remains between us.
Of course, chef, I know how to keep silent.
Now we will open and inspect the goods.
You will be very pleased with the purchase.

meanings.note: the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order
the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
I can see the toy car.

вовремя.gloss: on time, at the right moment

meanings.en: on time, at the right moment

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence
polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)
to choose, select; to use up completely (quotas, limits)

examples.text: В этом году все квоты выбрали.
examples.trans: This year all the quotas have been used up.
She chose the most beautiful dress.

meanings.en: to fulfil, to keep, to carry out
meanings.note: an order, promise, or part of a deal

examples.trans: I kept my part of the deal.

meanings.note: neuter главное, used as a noun

examples.trans: The main thing is, don't worry.

meanings.note: short form: ты довольна? = are you happy?

examples.trans: He talks for a long time.
In the kitchen they are preparing this order.
I was born and grew up here.
Who was that guy in the corridor?
He is standing in the long corridor.
We were putting it into boxes.
A big box was standing on the floor.

meanings.note: лучший в мире = the best in the world
meжду нами = between us; между прочим = by the way, for your information

examples.trans: For your information, I am the chairman of the court.

между.governs: instrumental (or genitive in a few set phrases)

молчать.gloss: to be silent, to say nothing

meanings.en: to be silent, to keep quiet
meanings.note: почему ты молчишь? = why aren't you saying anything?

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
needs 'не' with the verb: никто не войдёт

examples.trans: I know the town like nobody else.

оказаться.gloss: to turn out to be, find oneself

meanings.en: to turn out to be, prove to be

examples.trans: You turned out to be ungrateful.

examples.text: Он внезапно оказался в центре событий.
examples.trans: He suddenly found himself in the center of events.

meanings.note: ничего не осталось = there's nothing left

examples.trans: I know this town really well!
I love our town very much.

meanings.note: act of buying or item bought

examples.text: Это договор на покупку строительного оборудования.
examples.trans: This is a contract for the purchase of construction equipment.
What did you bring into the flat?

meanings.en: to check, to test, to verify

examples.text: Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!
examples.trans: Listen, Nina, this is that very restaurant!

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.

meanings.note: forms the superlative: самый главный = the most important

examples.trans: The most important thing is the people.

examples.text: Совершенно верно, я мэр этого города.
examples.trans: Quite right, I am the mayor of this town.
This is a completely new car.

meanings.en: to put, to place in an upright position

examples.trans: Where should I put the plate?
Put the kettle on the table.
We will sit together in a friendly way at the table.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: in weight, or тяжёлый металл = heavy metal

examples.text: Я вообще в школе тяжёлый металл любила!
examples.trans: In school I actually loved heavy metal!

уметь.gloss: to know how to, to be able to

examples.trans: I'm calling to say thank you.
I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
